scope_retrieval.known_background: The unsigned partition-rank identity is standard; the defining convention and elementary-symmetric formula were read in NIST DLMF Section 26.8(i), equation 26.8.3, and are independently proved in restoration.md.
scope_retrieval.precise_operator_theorem_search: No independently sourced statement of the precise operator-history theorem was identified. This does not establish novelty.
scope_retrieval.external_theorem_assumptions: None: the elementary algebra used here is proved directly. Staged analytic inputs remain explicit conditional assumptions.

conclusion.statement: For every finite memory cutoff, repeated numerical values and arbitrary permitted batch sizes, the actual birth-address multipliers preserve symmetric factorial memories and both absolute adjoint bounds. Equality rank r affects at most min(N,2r) edges, so the manuscript's low-rank and high-rank restoration estimates follow from its stated signed and positive inputs.
conclusion.finite_hybrid_bound: abs(Z_distinct) <= sum_r c(A,r) min(U delta^r, V Q^min(N,2r)), where c(A,r)=[t^r] product_{j=0}^{A-1}(1+j t).

definitions.U: b_mass times all positive weighted ghost and edge row constants
definitions.V: b_norm times all birth-modified ghost norm bounds H_j and all unrestricted signed edge bounds S_i
definitions.Q: max(1,max_i K_i/S_i), with S_i>0 and K_i>=S_i
definitions.delta: uniform maximal atom of the independent fresh laws
definitions.b_mass: value-independent factorized initial positive majorant, not a smaller mass obtained after conditioning initial labels
definitions.b_norm: product of the two boundary Hilbert norms

essential_hypotheses: Fresh laws have total mass at least one.
Before fresh integrations, step, promotion counts, damping and Schur-weight ratios are fixed; coefficients and exclusions admit value-independent positive majorants.
The initial boundary admits the same factorized fresh-law majorization.
Birth multipliers are equivariant under old-index relabelling; ordered ghost-batch multipliers are averaged inside their existing factorial integral.
Both positive weighted Schur directions and the unmodified signed edge contraction are available uniformly in the cutoff.

refutation_assessment.old_index_obstruction: A raw multiplier selecting one old index can fail to preserve symmetry. This is not a counterexample to positive domination or the symmetrically compressed bound.
refutation_assessment.actual_birth_modifications: They satisfy the Poisson-Dirichlet equivariance restriction and preserve the asserted histories; no F_ claim or manuscript refutes judgement is asserted.
